title: VAST G1-J8 song file (.websynth.json)
description: Portable song format for the VAST G1-J8 web synthesizer (package name: websynth). A song captures the full parameter snapshot plus all sequencer / drum / sampler / motion banks and the four arrangement chain lanes. The format is additive and forward-compatible: new fields are optional and defaulted, so older files keep loading. Validation mirrors the loader contract — strict on types/structure/ranges/dimensions, lenient on the optional per-step fields (legacy v1 cells omit them). Unknown extra keys are tolerated (forward-compat); decoded audio is never embedded (only sampler filenames persist). Canonical runtime validation is the hand-written validator in src/state/song-validate.ts; this schema is the published machine-readable mirror.

format.description: Required discriminator. Always the literal string 'websynth-song'.

version.description: Format version. capture() always writes 7 (the highest in this enum); every earlier version still loads because each addition is optional — v1 files (incl. some built-in demos) lack the sampler fields, v2 files lack the XY Pad assignment, v3 files lack the motion-sequencer fields, v4 files lack 'motionTracks', v5 files lack 'seqTracks' and v6 files lack 'seqTranspose'. Versions beyond those this build knows are rejected.

name.description: Human-readable song name (also the localStorage slot key and export filename stem).

params.description: Flat ParamBus snapshot: dotted parameter id -> scalar value (e.g. 'filter.cutoff', 'fx.delay.mix', 'drum.t0.tune'). Key NAMES are intentionally NOT restricted, so files that carry params from a newer build still load; the count is capped at 512 (the bus registers ~150) and '__proto__' / 'constructor' / 'prototype' are refused.

additionalProperties.description: A finite scalar. (JSON cannot encode NaN/Infinity, so non-finite values cannot appear here.)

drumBanks.description: 4 drum banks, each 8 tracks (Kick, Snare, C.Hat, O.Hat, L.Tom, M.Tom, H.Tom, Clap) x 16 steps.

seqTranspose.description: v7 (optional). One semitone offset per 'seqChain' slot, parallel to seqChain.steps — so one bank can carry a whole progression (A, A+5, A+7, A+3). A sibling of 'seqChain' rather than a field inside it, so chainData keeps its exact shape and pre-v7 files round-trip byte-identically. Omitted when every offset is 0. Applied to the note the sequencer TRIGGERS, clamped to MIDI 0..127 — the stored bank is never rewritten. Only the seq lane is pitched; the drum, sampler and motion chains have no equivalent.

samplerBanks.description: v2 (optional). 4 sampler banks, each 8 slots x 16 steps.

sampleNames.description: v2 (optional). One filename per sampler slot, or null for an empty slot. Filenames ONLY — decoded audio is never embedded; the user reloads the files after import.

xy.description: v3 (optional). XY Pad axis assignment — which ParamBus param each axis drives. Only the assignment persists; live dragged values are momentary and never written. Absent = default (filter.cutoff x filter.resonance).

x.description: ParamBus id driven by the horizontal axis.

y.description: ParamBus id driven by the vertical axis (up = more).

motionBanks.description: v4 (optional). 4 motion-sequencer banks, each exactly 16 steps of XY anchors. During playback the motion machine drives the XY-assigned params through the ON steps (slide = linear interpolation between anchors, step = jump-and-hold; 'motion.slide' param).

motionAssigns.description: v4 (optional). Per-bank axis override; null = the bank inherits the song's 'xy' assignment. An entry may override only one axis.

x.description: ParamBus id driven by this bank's x anchors.

y.description: ParamBus id driven by this bank's y anchors.

seqTracks.description: v6 (optional). Sequencer tracks 2-4 per bank, indexed by the REAL track number — index 0 is always null because track 1 lives in 'seqBanks'. An unused track is null. Tracks 2-4 only sound in poly voicing.

motionTracks.description: v5 (optional). Per motion bank, 2 extra single-param tracks (A, B). Each picks its own ParamBus id and holds its own 16 anchors, so a bank can automate up to 4 params, or just these 2 while keeping the XY Pad free for live playing. A track that is unassigned and empty is null and writes nothing.

param.description: ParamBus id this track drives. Absent = the track writes nothing.

$comment: additionalProperties is intentionally NOT forbidden at the root: the format is additive/forward-compatible, so a file carrying keys from a newer build still validates.

motionTrackStep.description: One extra-track step. 'on' makes it an anchor; 'v' is 0..1 in normalized taper space (same space as motionStep's x/y).

stepSettings.description: Per-step settings shared by all three machines. All fields are OPTIONAL on disk: legacy cells omit them and the loader fills defaults (velocity 0.85, gate 1, prob 1, ratchet 1, tie false, micro 0). When present they are type/range-checked.

gate.description: 0..1 of one step. Drum/sampler: 1 = natural decay (let ring); <1 chokes the hit early.

tie.description: Hold into the next step (seq: legato/slide; drum/sampler: skip the choke).

micro.description: Micro-timing: integer -12..12 in 1/24 of the step's own cell. Negative = early, positive = late. Default 0.

seqStep.description: A sequencer step. Requires on + note; the per-step settings (velocity/gate/prob/ratchet/tie/micro) are optional and defaulted.

on.description: Whether this step triggers a note.

triggerCell.description: A one-shot trigger cell — the drum-machine and sampler step shape. Requires on; the per-step settings are optional and defaulted.

motionStep.description: A motion-sequencer step: an optional XY anchor. x/y are the assigned params' normalized 0..1 positions (taper space, like the XY pad surface). A dead step is { on: false } (x/y optional).

on.description: Whether this step is an anchor.

chainData.description: An arrangement chain lane: an ordered list of bank indices, advanced one slot per bar.

enabled.description: Whether the chain drives this lane's play bank (a disabled lane tracks its edit bank).

steps.description: Ordered bank indices (0..3 = A/B/C/D), or -1 for a rest (an always-empty bar). At most 1024 slots — 1024 bars is ~34 minutes at 120 BPM.
